bank.title: Workplace English Core
bank.description: Generic business email and workplace phone scenarios without personal or industry-specific information.

items.title: 確認收到資料
items.scenarioZh: 對方寄來你先前要求的資料。你要簡短確認已收到，不需要加入其他承諾。

steps.promptZh: 哪一句最適合直接確認收件？

options.text: Thank you. I have received the documents.
options.feedback: 現在完成式能自然表達資料已經收到。

options.text: I receive the documents, thank you.
options.feedback: receive 使用現在簡單式，不能自然表達剛完成的收件結果。

options.text: The documents I already received.
options.feedback: 這是直接套用中文語序；英文通常以主詞 I 開始。

steps.promptZh: 依英文語序重組確認句。
steps.explanation: 主詞 I 後接 have received，再放受詞 the documents。
steps.incorrectFeedback: 英文基本順序是主詞＋動詞＋受詞。

production.promptZh: 不看答案，寫一句「謝謝，我已收到資料」。
production.target: Thank you. I have received the documents.
accepted: Thank you. I have received the documents.
Thank you, I have received the documents.
I have received the documents. Thank you.
production.explanation: 句子簡短、清楚，也沒有加入不必要的承諾。

commonMistakes.example: I receive the documents, thank you.
commonMistakes.feedback: 改用 have received 表達已完成的收件結果。

items.title: 請對方補件
items.scenarioZh: 收到的資料缺少一份文件。你需要禮貌請對方在星期五前補寄。
facts: 語氣需要明確但不命令

steps.promptZh: 哪一句最符合一般商務語氣？

options.text: Could you please send the missing document by Friday?
options.feedback: Could you please 清楚表達請求，by Friday 表示最晚期限。

options.text: You must send me the missing document before Friday.
options.feedback: must 和 send me 過於命令式；before Friday 也可能被理解為不包含星期五。

options.text: Please supply me the lack document until Friday.
options.feedback: lack document 不自然；supply 應使用 supply someone with something 或 supply something to someone；期限應使用 by Friday。

steps.promptZh: 填入表示「最晚在星期五前」的介系詞。
steps.before: Could you please send the missing document
steps.explanation: by Friday 表示最晚不超過星期五。
steps.incorrectFeedback: 表示截止期限時使用 by，不使用 until。

production.promptZh: 寫一句禮貌請對方星期五前補寄文件。
production.target: Could you please send the missing document by Friday?
accepted: Could you please send the missing document by Friday?
Could you send the missing document by Friday, please?
production.explanation: 請求、內容與期限都明確，語氣也不過度強硬。

commonMistakes.example: Please send the missing document until Friday.
commonMistakes.feedback: 截止期限應使用 by Friday。

items.title: 重寄附件
items.scenarioZh: 對方表示沒有看到附件。你重新附上檔案，並簡短告知對方。
facts: for your reference 可表示供參考

steps.promptZh: 哪一句自然地告知附件已重寄？

options.text: I have attached the file again for your reference.
options.feedback: attached the file again 清楚表示重新附檔。

options.text: I resend attachment to you again.
options.feedback: attachment 前缺少冠詞，而且 resend 與 again 重複表意。

options.text: Please find again the attachment.
options.feedback: again 放在這個位置不自然，也沒有清楚說明是重新附上。

steps.promptZh: 重組一句簡短的附件通知。
steps.explanation: 先說明動作，再放受詞與 again，最後補充用途。
steps.incorrectFeedback: again 通常放在受詞後方，比放在句首自然。

production.promptZh: 寫一句告知已重新附上檔案。
production.target: I have attached the file again for your reference.
accepted: I have attached the file again for your reference.
I have reattached the file for your reference.
Please find the file attached again for your reference.
production.explanation: 訊息直接，不需要解釋對方為什麼沒看到附件。

commonMistakes.example: I resend attachment to you again.
commonMistakes.feedback: 使用 have attached the file again，並補上 the。

items.title: 詢問進度
items.scenarioZh: 你已提出一項請求，目前尚未收到後續消息。你要禮貌詢問最新進度。
facts: 使用 request 代表先前事項

steps.promptZh: 哪一句中性且適合一般商務往來？

options.text: Could you please provide an update on the request?
options.feedback: provide an update on 是自然的進度詢問搭配。

options.text: Why haven't you finished the request?
options.feedback: 這句直接指責對方未完成，不適合作為一般進度詢問。

options.text: Could you tell me the request progress?
options.feedback: 句子可以理解並使用，但 an update on the request 更自然。

steps.promptZh: 填入與 update 搭配、表示「關於」的介系詞。
steps.before: Could you please provide an update
steps.explanation: 英文慣用搭配是 an update on something。
steps.incorrectFeedback: update 在此與 on 搭配。

production.promptZh: 寫一句禮貌詢問目前進度。
production.target: Could you please provide an update on the request?
accepted: Could you please provide an update on the request?
Could you please give me an update on the request?
May I ask for an update on the request?
production.explanation: 這句不預設責任歸屬，適合一般追蹤。

commonMistakes.example: Could you provide me the request progress?
commonMistakes.feedback: 改用 provide an update on the request 會更自然。

items.title: 更正先前資訊
items.scenarioZh: 你先前寄出的會議時間有誤，需要清楚告知正確時間是下午兩點。
facts: 需要明確指出正確資訊

steps.promptZh: 哪一句最清楚地引出更正？

options.text: Please note that the correct meeting time is 2:00 p.m.
options.feedback: Please note that 能自然提示對方注意更正資訊。

options.text: The meeting time should correct to 2:00 p.m.
options.feedback: should correct 缺少被動形式，而且整句結構不自然。

options.text: I wrong the meeting time. It is 2:00 p.m.
options.feedback: wrong 不能在此直接作動詞使用。

steps.promptZh: 重組更正句。
steps.explanation: Please note that 後面接完整子句。
steps.incorrectFeedback: that 後方需要主詞與動詞完整的子句。

production.promptZh: 寫一句告知正確會議時間是下午兩點。
production.target: Please note that the correct meeting time is 2:00 p.m.
accepted: Please note that the correct meeting time is 2:00 p.m.
Please note that the meeting time is 2:00 p.m.
The correct meeting time is 2:00 p.m.
production.explanation: 先提示更正，再直接給出正確資訊，清楚而簡潔。

commonMistakes.example: The meeting time should correct to 2:00 p.m.
commonMistakes.feedback: 直接使用 the correct meeting time is 2:00 p.m.。

items.title: 安排或確認時間
items.scenarioZh: 你提出星期二上午十點，想確認對方是否方便。
facts: 保留讓對方回覆的空間

steps.promptZh: 哪一句最自然地確認時間？

options.text: Could you please confirm whether Tuesday at 10:00 a.m. works for you?
options.feedback: whether...works for you 是自然的時間確認方式。

options.text: Please confirm Tuesday 10:00 a.m. is convenient or not.
options.feedback: 時間前缺少 at；直接把「是否方便」翻成 convenient or not，語序也不自然。

options.text: Can you attend Tuesday at 10:00 a.m.?
options.feedback: 句子可以使用，但語氣較直接，也把原本的確認方便時間限縮成是否出席。

steps.promptZh: 填入表示「是否」的連接詞。
steps.after: Tuesday at 10:00 a.m. works for you?
steps.explanation: whether 或 if 都能引導間接的是非問題。
steps.incorrectFeedback: confirm 後可用 whether 或 if 引導完整子句。

production.promptZh: 寫一句確認星期二上午十點是否方便。
production.target: Could you please confirm whether Tuesday at 10:00 a.m. works for you?
accepted: Could you please confirm whether Tuesday at 10:00 a.m. works for you?
Could you please confirm if Tuesday at 10:00 a.m. works for you?
Does Tuesday at 10:00 a.m. work for you?
production.explanation: 時間與確認目的都完整，對方也能直接回答。

commonMistakes.example: Please confirm Tuesday at 10:00 a.m. convenient or not.
commonMistakes.feedback: 使用 whether...works for you 組成完整子句。

items.title: 接聽電話與開場
items.scenarioZh: 工作電話響起。你需要先問候、感謝來電，再詢問可以如何協助。

steps.promptZh: 哪一組開場最完整？

options.text: Good morning. Thank you for calling. How may I help you?
options.feedback: 包含問候、感謝與協助問題，適合一般工作電話。

options.text: Hello, what do you want?
options.feedback: what do you want 過於直接，聽起來不耐煩。

options.text: Good morning. How can I help?
options.feedback: 句子可以使用，但加上 Thank you for calling 會更完整。

steps.promptZh: 依電話開場順序排列。
steps.explanation: 先問候，再感謝來電，最後詢問需求。
steps.incorrectFeedback: 電話開場應先建立禮貌語境，再詢問對方需求。

production.promptZh: 寫出一句完整的上午電話開場。
production.target: Good morning. Thank you for calling. How may I help you?
accepted: Good morning. Thank you for calling. How may I help you?
Good morning. Thank you for calling. How can I help you?
production.explanation: 這套開場可以固定背熟，電話響起時直接使用。

commonMistakes.example: Good morning. What can I help you?
commonMistakes.feedback: 應說 How can I help you，而不是 What can I help you。

items.title: 詢問姓名與公司
items.scenarioZh: 來電者尚未自我介紹。你需要禮貌詢問姓名與公司名稱。
facts: 避免直接說 Who are you

steps.promptZh: 哪一句最適合電話中詢問身分？

options.text: May I have your name and company name, please?
options.feedback: May I have...please 是常見且禮貌的電話用語。

options.text: Who are you and where are you from?
options.feedback: 語氣像質問，而且 where are you from 不等於公司名稱。

options.text: Can you give me your name and your company?
options.feedback: 句子可以理解並使用，但 May I have... 更符合電話接待語氣。

steps.promptZh: 填入電話中禮貌取得資訊的動詞。
steps.after: your name and company name, please?
steps.explanation: May I have... 是詢問姓名、電話等資訊的固定句型。
steps.incorrectFeedback: 此處使用 have，不需要使用 know 或 get。

production.promptZh: 寫一句禮貌詢問姓名與公司。
production.target: May I have your name and company name, please?
accepted: May I have your name and company name, please?
Could I have your name and company name, please?
May I have your name and company, please?
Could I have your name and company, please?
production.explanation: 可把這句當作固定電話句型，不必臨時組句。

commonMistakes.example: Who are you and what is your company?
commonMistakes.feedback: 改用 May I have... 可以避免質問感。

items.title: 請對方稍候
items.scenarioZh: 你需要短暫查找資訊，想請來電者在線上稍候。

steps.promptZh: 哪一句最適合請對方稍候？

options.text: Could you please hold for a moment?
options.feedback: hold for a moment 是標準電話用語。

options.text: Wait a minute.
options.feedback: 命令語氣太直接；電話中應使用 could you please。

options.text: Please wait me for a moment.
options.feedback: wait 不能直接接 me；電話情境使用 hold 更自然。

steps.promptZh: 重組請對方稍候的固定句。
steps.explanation: Could you please 後接原形動詞 hold。
steps.incorrectFeedback: please 後面要接動詞原形。

production.promptZh: 寫一句請來電者稍候片刻。
production.target: Could you please hold for a moment?
accepted: Could you please hold for a moment?
Would you mind holding for a moment?
Please hold for a moment.
production.explanation: 這是能在腦袋空白時直接取用的固定救援句。

commonMistakes.example: Please wait me for a moment.
commonMistakes.feedback: 電話中改用 hold for a moment。

items.title: 轉接電話
items.scenarioZh: 你已確認對方需求，需要把電話轉給適合的人員。

steps.promptZh: 哪一句清楚告知即將轉接？

options.text: I'll transfer you to the appropriate person.
options.feedback: transfer you to 是正確搭配，appropriate person 保持情境通用。

options.text: I transfer your phone to someone.
options.feedback: 轉接的是來電者，不是對方的電話；也需要使用 will。

options.text: I will let another person answer you.
options.feedback: 可以猜到意思，但不符合常見電話轉接用語。

steps.promptZh: 填入表示「轉接」的動詞。
steps.explanation: transfer someone to... 表示把某人的電話轉接給另一方。
steps.incorrectFeedback: 此處使用 transfer，表示把來電者轉接給另一方。

production.promptZh: 寫一句告知來電者你將進行轉接。
production.target: I'll transfer you to the appropriate person.
accepted: I'll transfer you to the appropriate person.
I will transfer you to the appropriate person.
Let me transfer you to the appropriate person.
production.explanation: 不需要臨時想部門名稱，也能清楚告知下一步。

commonMistakes.example: I'll transfer your phone to another person.
commonMistakes.feedback: 應說 transfer you，而不是 transfer your phone。

items.title: 對方不在與詢問留言
items.scenarioZh: 來電者要找的人目前無法接聽。你需要說明狀況並詢問是否留言。

steps.promptZh: 哪一句最完整且不透露多餘資訊？

options.text: I'm sorry, they are unavailable at the moment. Would you like to leave a message?
options.feedback: unavailable 不透露原因，後面直接提供留言選項。

options.text: They are not here. Do you have anything to say?
options.feedback: 語氣過於生硬，anything to say 也不像正式的留言詢問。

options.text: They cannot answer you because they are busy.
options.feedback: 沒有必要猜測或透露無法接聽的原因。

steps.promptZh: 依序重組「目前不在＋是否留言」。
tokens: They are unavailable at the moment.
steps.explanation: 先交代狀況，再提出留言選項。
steps.incorrectFeedback: 先說明無法接聽，再詢問留言，對方比較容易理解。

production.promptZh: 寫一句說明目前無法接聽並詢問是否留言。
production.target: I'm sorry, they are unavailable at the moment. Would you like to leave a message?
accepted: I'm sorry, they are unavailable at the moment. Would you like to leave a message?
They are unavailable at the moment. Would you like to leave a message?
production.explanation: 這句避免透露原因，同時讓通話能繼續往留言流程前進。

commonMistakes.example: They are not here. Do you want to say something?
commonMistakes.feedback: 改用 unavailable 與 leave a message，語氣會更專業。

items.title: 確認電話與資訊
items.scenarioZh: 來電者提供聯絡電話。你需要在記錄後再次確認號碼。

steps.promptZh: 哪一句適合在重複號碼前使用？

options.text: Let me confirm your phone number.
options.feedback: Let me confirm... 自然地提示接下來要核對資訊。

options.text: I confirm again your phone.
options.feedback: again 的位置與 your phone 的用法都不自然。

options.text: Tell me your number one more time.
options.feedback: 這是在要求對方重說，不是主動核對已記錄的內容。

steps.promptZh: 填入表示「確認、核對」的動詞。
steps.explanation: confirm information 表示確認資訊是否正確。

production.promptZh: 寫一句表示要確認來電者的電話號碼。
production.target: Let me confirm your phone number.
accepted: Let me confirm your phone number.
Let me confirm the phone number.
May I confirm your phone number?
production.explanation: 說完這句後，再逐位念出已記錄的號碼即可。

commonMistakes.example: Let me check again your phone number.
commonMistakes.feedback: 若使用 again，應放在句尾；此處直接用 confirm 最簡潔。

items.title: 告知會請對方回電
items.scenarioZh: 你已記下留言，需要告知來電者會請對方回電，但不承諾確切時間。

steps.promptZh: 哪一句不會做出過度承諾？

options.text: I'll ask them to return your call.
options.feedback: ask them to 表示你會轉達，但沒有替對方保證結果或時間。

options.text: They will call you back immediately.
options.feedback: 除非已確認，否則不應替他人承諾立即回電。

options.text: I will tell them call back to you.
options.feedback: tell 後需接 to call；return your call 或 call you back 更自然。

steps.promptZh: 重組不過度承諾的回電句。
steps.explanation: ask someone to do something 是固定結構。
steps.incorrectFeedback: ask them 後面使用 to 加動詞原形。

production.promptZh: 寫一句告知會請對方回電。
production.target: I'll ask them to return your call.
accepted: I'll ask them to return your call.
I will ask them to return your call.
I'll ask them to call you back.
production.explanation: 這句完成轉達承諾，但沒有替另一個人保證回電時間。

commonMistakes.example: I will tell them call back to you.
commonMistakes.feedback: 使用 ask them to return your call。

items.title: 聽不清楚與救援句
items.scenarioZh: 你沒有聽清楚來電者剛才說的內容。你需要立即使用固定句，請對方重複。

steps.promptZh: 腦袋空白時，哪一句最安全實用？

options.text: I'm sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you please repeat it?
options.feedback: didn't catch that 是自然的沒聽清楚表達，後面直接提出請求。

options.text: What? Say it again.
options.feedback: 過於直接，容易聽起來不耐煩。

options.text: Sorry, my English is not good.
options.feedback: 不需要貶低自己的英文；直接說沒聽清楚更有效。

steps.promptZh: 填入表示「沒聽清楚」的動詞。
steps.after: that. Could you please repeat it?
steps.explanation: I didn't catch that 是常見電話救援句。
steps.incorrectFeedback: 此處使用 catch，表示沒有聽清楚或理解剛才的話。

production.promptZh: 寫出一句請對方重複的完整救援句。
production.target: I'm sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you please repeat it?
accepted: I'm sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you please repeat it?
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you please repeat it?
I'm sorry, could you please repeat that?
production.explanation: 這句值得整組背熟；卡住時不需要重新組合文法。

commonMistakes.example: Sorry, I didn't listen clearly. Please say again.
commonMistakes.feedback: say 後缺少受詞；可說 Please say it again，電話中使用 I didn't catch that 與 Could you please repeat it? 更自然。
